title: Superpowers Skills Framework
summary: Comprehensive agentic software development methodology from obra/superpowers. Contains 14 skills covering: brainstorming (design before code), writing-plans (implementation plans), executing-plans (batch execution), subagent-driven-development (fresh subagent per task with two-stage review), test-driven-development (RED-GREEN-REFACTOR), systematic-debugging (4-phase root cause analysis), verification-before-completion (evidence before claims), requesting-code-review, receiving-code-review, using-git-worktrees (isolated workspaces), finishing-a-development-branch, dispatching-parallel-agents, writing-skills, and using-superpowers (core skill discovery). Skills are installed locally at .claude/skills/ within the project directory.
